**Step:** [step-11](../README.md) — Does iteration 4's Track 2 chain (phenotype twin, PrimeKG walk, screen sweep, signature reversal, convergence, checks) run on a second rare disease, Bloom syndrome (BLM), by configuration alone, and does it propose a different drug set?

## The claim

P4-31: iteration 4's Track 2 chain runs on a second rare disease, Bloom syndrome, by configuration alone, and proposes a drug set distinct from the MVA case's

**Prediction if true.** With a case configuration for Bloom syndrome (gene BLM, its disease node in PrimeKG and MONDO, its HPO terms read from phenotype.hpoa, a lineage contrast fixed from the literature before the run), and zero source-code lines changed: (a) every stage writes its table with a provenance manifest - the phenotype twin over MGI, the PrimeKG walk, the PRISM sweep, LINCS reversal (or a recorded reason it has no BLM signature), convergence with its null, and checks K1 and K3 (K2 runs its label half only, with no patient genome); (b) the phenotype twin ranks a Blm genotype in the top 5 % of MGI genotypes; (c) the union of the four generator lists shares at most 20 % of its drugs with the MVA case's union (Jaccard index <= 0.20)

**What would refute it.** Any source-code change is needed to run the second case, or any stage fails to write its table, or the Blm twin ranks outside the top 25 %, or the Jaccard index of the two unions exceeds 0.50

Nothing observed yet. This claim is proposed, not tested.
